intermediate_decisions.business_role: 阻止无法排定顺序的材料进入段
intermediate_decisions.current_rule: qualification!=1或与任意同侧Wall event同UTI→unresolved_f4；其余qualification==1才accepted_f4。unresolved生成Formation还要求该UTI在axis内且wall_id>0
intermediate_decisions.run_result_location: Formation body=2 availability=5 reason=2；无完整原F4身份附件

intermediate_decisions.business_role: 使多资格行只形成一次材料量
intermediate_decisions.current_rule: 所有amount和volume以rtol=0/atol=1e-9一致性检查；每family置flag并取最高grade；不跨family重复累加amount。遇到未知family code拒绝
intermediate_decisions.run_result_location: 中间dense不正式导出；段量/掩码/资格明细保留部分结果

intermediate_decisions.business_role: 建立可开启/续接攻段的材料
intermediate_decisions.current_rule: wall_id>0；side为bid/ask；require_alive_wall=True；bid用sell_hit_px/vol，ask用buy_hit_px/vol；至少一family命中；deal/core>0；round(abs(deal-core)/tick_size)<=p_attack_ticks。band仅携带，不是此资格的比较界
intermediate_decisions.run_result_location: 只有accepted形成材料位置及段聚合；完整atom tape NOT_EXPOSED

intermediate_decisions.business_role: 保留family重叠而不重复算段总量
intermediate_decisions.current_rule: core双lane金额不一致或双lane时volume为NaN→隔离atom(qualification=2/flag=0/amount=volume=0)；accepted atom一个材料累加一次total；每命中lane另加其overlap view。不可相加两个overlap当total
intermediate_decisions.run_result_location: 段聚合可导出；core隔离atom本身无正式tape
unconfirmed_items: wrapper已提前拒绝流间amount/volume不一致，core隔离分支在本实例的实际可达性未验证

intermediate_decisions.current_rule: 先检查旧段到该atom前的最早close；无旧段即新建并分配id。否则Wall id变化先wall_switch；再按split flag检查side_switch；切换时旧段closed_at=新atom位置，新段另分id；其余append
intermediate_decisions.run_result_location: 正式段与qualified UTI；在建state不正式导出
unconfirmed_items: wrapper分bid/ask运行；side_switch存在分支不证明实际出现

intermediate_decisions.business_role: 分开业务末点与真实关闭点
intermediate_decisions.current_rule: 在(last_atom_uti, up_to_uti]找wall cut；gap在UTI严格大于last+t_gap的第一个实际Tick；retreat见D08。按最小UTI选cut，同UTI按候选列表wall、gap、retreat顺序稳定取首。atom前扫描的retreat严格排除当前atom UTI；chunk尾另扫描trailing cut
intermediate_decisions.run_result_location: close_reason_code、closed_at；未暴露所有竞争候选或逐Tick原因轨迹

intermediate_decisions.business_role: 可在没有新F4材料时关闭段
intermediate_decisions.current_rule: 只检查同Wall且Alive并且price/core有限的Tick；ask反向距离=max(round((core-price)/tick_size),0)，bid=max(round((price-core)/tick_size),0)；严格>阈值才close。另记录相对段内atom最佳价的retreat_from_best；它不是闭段距离定义
intermediate_decisions.run_result_location: 闭段原因及聚合；完整Tick扫描不导出

intermediate_decisions.business_role: 避免以技术边界制造业务段/材料
intermediate_decisions.current_rule: 段状态/id跨chunk传递；chunk_end不无条件闭段；全范围结束也无额外强制flush段。Formation同key相邻chunk首段合并；interval finalize由最后chunk或trade_day变化决定。carry/checkpoint不制造Formation

intermediate_decisions.business_role: 解释无accepted材料和能力缺失
intermediate_decisions.current_rule: Alive且本Tick无accepted atom时，availability==1→body4/availability1/reason4；其它→body5/原availability/reason5；同key连续区间压缩。每段Alive Wall区间另输出body6/availability6、reason6 near-miss及reason8 band-shift声明；不再声明retreat不可观察

intermediate_decisions.business_role: 给完整段保留真正参与的所选流/族/档位

自由、派生、preset、实例身份和工程常量分开；实际构造证据与未核运行receipt分开
公开布局逐流/逐字段映射；当前结果UNCONFIRMED，内部未导出字段NOT_EXPOSED；历史候选没有升级为AVAILABLE
缺receipt/正式结果、实际scope、可达性、信息可得时间和参考合同差异具名；没有实现修正、参数建议或合理性结论
